tauri_event:rpc_from_sidecar.note: Delivers the sidecar's lines to the UI. Ours is sidecar://line. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), Conductor's frontend listened to it and our app delivered 120 calls through sidecar://line in 119 states.

tauri_event:pty-ready.note: A terminal is ready. Ours answers pty_spawn once the terminal runs, so the UI needs no event (pty.rs). No catalogue state runs a terminal in Conductor's frontend; ours is shown by pty.rs plat_07_spawn_starts_a_command_and_returns_its_exit.

tauri_event:pty-data.note: Terminal output for the UI. Ours sends it on the Channel passed to pty_spawn, as base64 chunks with their byte length (pty.rs). No catalogue state runs a terminal in Conductor's frontend; ours is shown by pty.rs plat_07_output_chunks_are_base64_encoded.

tauri_event:pty-exit.note: A terminal's process ended. Ours is pty://exit. No catalogue state runs a terminal in Conductor's frontend; ours is shown by pty.rs plat_07_spawn_starts_a_command_and_returns_its_exit.

tauri_event:raw-websocket-event.note: Messages of the WebSocket to Conductor's own server (main @2942811). Our cloud relay's lines are cloud://line (D018).

tauri_event:remote-file-sync-direct-info.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_event:remote-file-sync-status.note: CLOUD-11's sync runs over the Worker's file routes through the Host interface, which D018 put in place of Conductor's native file-sync commands and events.

tauri_event:agent_binary_progress.note: An agent program's download progress. Ours is programs://status. In stage 2's run of 2026-11-13 on this branch (its first 200 states), Conductor's frontend listened to it and our app delivered 120 calls through programs://status in 119 states.

tauri_event:port-forward-token-request.note: D110: the pairing token stays in Rust, so the token-request event is not built.

tauri_event:port-forward-event.note: Reports a forward's state to the UI, which uses it for the SSH keepalive of Conductor's SSH-based forwarding (main @3870859). D110 forwards over one WebSocket per connection through the Worker, and the service reads the forwards itself.
